turns.text: Hello. The print arrived with the wrong colours. The sky is green and it should be blue.

Hello, I'm sorry the print arrived with the wrong colours. To help, I need to verify your order first. Please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5219, email nymue.strambu@example.com. It was delivered recently.

Thank you, Nymue. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for your print Cameleonul de noapte (30x40 cm), because the sky arrived green instead of blue. The claim is pending, and staff must approve it. Staff will ask you for a photo of the print and decide on the solution, which is either a reprint or a refund. If you already know which you prefer, tell me and I will add it to the claim.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Print 'Cameleonul de noapte' (30x40 cm) arrived with wrong colours: the sky is green but should be blue.

turns.text: I have a photo for the team. I do not know whether I want a reprint or a refund, so I will let them decide after they see the photo.

Thank you. Staff will ask for the photo, and they will decide between a reprint and a refund once they have seen it. Your claim R-1 stays pending until a colleague approves it. Please keep the photo ready for when they ask.
